## [GitHub Releases · Crush: v0.44.0](https://github.com/charmbracelet/crush/releases/tag/v0.44.0)
*GitHub Releases · Crush* | 22/02/2026 | Score: 1.00
Tags: product_launch, tool_update

> # Smallish Rendering Things You may have noticed we care about integrity in user interfaces a lot. That's what this small release is all about. ## Which skill? Skills are awesome, but currently a little mysterious in Crush, and we found ourselves asking whether a skill was loaded or the LLM was just improvising. Now it's super clear when skills are read in courtesy a little bit of visual flourish. ## Size Calcs We noticed some cases where a character or two would get clipped at certain widths, which was a little annoying. Now it's fixed. That's it for v0.44.0. See ya later! ✌️ ## Changelog ### New! * c1d294d161dbee0d1bd5061c3270050c980b8d98: feat(ui): indicate when skills are loaded (@meowgorithm) ### Fixed * 12a6372bee85e72b717aa407747395258ad40ee7: fix(ui): apply the message style to each line of the message items (@aymanbagabas) * e3376ad117f8cfd267fa8a94221662b45e58d44a: fix(ui): fix cases where compact header and footer bleed off screen (#2279) (@meowgorithm) ### Other stuff * d63
